output.answer: Article 33.3 of the 2023 FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations states that drivers must make every reasonable effort to use the track at all times and may not leave the track without a justifiable reason. A driver is deemed to have left the track if no part of the car remains in contact with the track, with the exception that white lines defining the track edges are considered part of the track, but kerbs are not. Rejoining the track is allowed only when it is safe to do so and without gaining any lasting advantage. The Race Director has the discretion to decide whether a driver should return the advantage gained from leaving the track.
